scope: This is an author-admission and candidate-construction floor, not a promotion or acceptance validator.

pre_author_manifest.manifest_self_binding: The adjacent manifest is captured once and its exact SHA-256 is supplied out of band.
pre_author_manifest.ciphertext: holdout-ciphertext.b64 is a direct manifest row and its captured bytes must exactly match holdout-receipt.json. No G2 ciphertext, plaintext, result, or key material may be reused.
pre_author_manifest.verdicts: Challenge A and B must each be JSON with scope PUBLIC_BOUNDARY_AND_AUTHOR_ADMISSION and verdict ACCEPT. root-gestalt.json must say ACCEPT and bind the exact captured review hashes and byte lengths.
pre_author_manifest.candidate_absence: The candidates directory must not exist when --pre-author succeeds.

captured_byte_law: The validator reads each precursor, manifest row, proof input, tool input, compiler source, and clean-base tree file once into immutable buffers. Parsing, hashing, TypeScript SourceFile construction, and decisions use those buffers. Exact file bytes and tree path sets are revalidated at close.

candidate_floor.exact_type: Parser<Readonly<{ value: number; type: 'integer' | 'number'; sign: '+' | '-' | null }>>
candidate_floor.positive_construction: Only direct public-combinator construction, direct Number conversion, tightly listed pure mapper methods, identifier variables, direct arrows, and ordinary object literals are admitted. Constructors, state/source identifiers, element access, object destructuring, reflection, symbols, proxies, dynamic import, mutation, casts, loops, custom functions/classes, mapState, call, parseState, aliases, and indirect calls fail mechanically.
candidate_floor.nonclaim: This floor is proportionate, not whole-program proof. Runtime truth, hidden semantic indirection, lineage, idiom, and KISS remain mandatory skeptic-review axes.

four_seats.receipt: Each receipt binds feature/generation/seat/topology, source SHA-256/bytes, a nonempty unique author_id, independent=true, and peer_source_access=false.
four_seats.cross_seat: All four source byte digests and all four author IDs must be pairwise distinct.

topologies.h: Exactly one exact whole-prefix regex call; no any, all, or dispatch.
topologies.b: Regex-terminal production tree with at least two any and two all calls; no string or dispatch.
topologies.s: Specification clauses with at least four string, two any, and one all call; no dispatch.
topologies.d: At least one dispatch table with +-, dot, and 0-9 buckets.

four_seats.skeptics: Four independent exact-byte skeptic receipts remain required by the later acceptance validator.

deferred_acceptance.validator: A separate post-author acceptance validator must be formed after authors; it is not fabricated in this precursor.
deferred_acceptance.law: Only that later validator may decide candidate acceptance. This author-admission validator cannot promote, integrate, project, or grant feature/parser/benchmark credit.

credit: ZERO before the separate acceptance validator succeeds.
